name: @nonsuch/component-library
description: A Vue 3 component library built on Quasar with opinionated defaults and custom components.

scripts.build: vite build && rm -f tsconfig.build.tsbuildinfo && vue-tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build

size-limit.name: full library (gzip) — a SOFT ceiling. 36.5 kB as of 2026-09-16: NsOrderSummaryTotals (componentLibrary-rbe.2) took it 35.17 → 36.19; `{ NsOrderSummaryTotals }` = 5.04 kB against `{ NsInput, NsChip, NsButton, nsLocaleEnCA }` = 4.06 (brotli, same ignores), so ~1 kB of its own — two dl lists, a real form with a v-model fallback, a removable chip row, and the `order` locale strings every locale consumer pays (~150 B). Set to 36.5 knowing NsBannerSelectedPlan (rbe.1, in flight) adds ~280 B → ~36.47. Earlier the same day, 35.5 kB: NsTooltipDetails (componentLibrary-605) took it 34.89 → 35.17 (35.06 before review added the dialog role, name and NsMenu's show/hide/toggle; 61 B over the old line); `{ NsTooltipDetails }` = 3.44 kB against `{ NsMenu, NsButton, nsLocaleEnCA }` = 3.12 (brotli, same ignores), so ~320 B of its own — a panel on NsMenu with a locale-named Close button. Before that, 35 kB as of 2026-09-15: NsPlanBuilder + NsPlanAddOn + NsBanner's two surface tones (componentLibrary-lrw.6.2) took it 32.83 → 34.26; `{ NsPlanBuilder }` = 6.37 kB against its dependencies `{ NsBanner, NsButton, NsBadge, NsSeparator, NsTabs, NsTab, nsLocaleEnCA }` = 4.49, so ~1.9 kB of its own — a tabbed two-level picker with two banners and its own locale strings. Set to 35 rather than 34.5 because lrw.6.3 (NsChooseACombo) is next and is small. Earlier the same day, 33 kB: NsCombo + NsPlanHeader/Highlights/Features (componentLibrary-lrw.5) took it 31.43 → 32.26, +830 B for four exported components, three of which NsPlanBuilder (lrw.6) will reuse; `{ NsCombo }` = 4.66 kB against `{ NsButton, nsLocaleEnCA }` = 3.47, so ~1.2 kB for the four together. Before that, 32 kB on 2026-09-14: NsChecklistBanner took it 30.17 → 31.38; `{ NsChecklistBanner }` = 4.97 kB against `{ NsBadge, NsButton, nsLocaleEnCA }` = 3.6, so ~1.2 kB of its own, ~0.2 of that the en-CA `checklist` strings every locale consumer pays. Earlier the same day, 31 kB: NsHoursOfOperation (componentLibrary-f6b) took it 26.78 → 30.16, the largest single addition to date — a compound input of eight days × (two selects, a checkbox, add and remove buttons) with its own live region and focus choreography; ~2 kB of it is the per-range row template, whose remove button appears twice so CSS can place it per breakpoint. Measured before bumping, gzip with vue/quasar/phosphor ignored: `{ NsHoursOfOperation }` = 7.16 kB; `{ NsSelect, NsCheckbox, NsButton }` = 3.42 kB; the same plus `nsLocaleEnCA` (which the component pulls through useNsLocale's default) = 4.16 kB. So the component's own code is ~3.0 kB counting the locale as a dependency, ~3.7 kB not. Previously 27 kB as of 2026-09-12 (NsImageUpload +1.8 kB across two review passes; the dev warnings are ~3.3 kB in total and only dual conditional exports reclaims them — see componentLibrary-49m). RE-SET rather than drift: when a bump is needed, write the reason here.
